dispositions.disposition: CORRECTED in source (UNREVIEWED); Windows/native not run
dispositions.characterised_contract: CITY registers the SHARED fixed-position setter (ct_funcs.c overload_fixed_functions (ENTITY_TYPE_CITY), fx_funcs.c overload_fixed_vec3d_functions, fx_vec3d.c set_local_vec3d), which deletes the entity from its sector list and inserts it again (head, NULL predecessor) whenever the position crosses a sector, and never touches the CITY_BUILDING list; the city registers no setter of its own (ct_vec3d.c). A session restore reaches the same setter. Every legitimate remove/reinsert therefore happens with the list attached. The destruction order (children first, ct_dstry.c) is a different path and is not changed or claimed as a finding. A source guard now asserts this chain and the derived names (entity_roster_guard.rs).
dispositions.representation: The host list and its children hang from the city RECORD (roster.rs lists/Child.parent keyed by the record id), which outlives the city sector placement while buildings are listed and ends with its last placement once the list is empty. The wire names a list by the key it was first named by (the city sector key at the first building); a key that is no live entry names its record while that record holds a placement or a list. A relinked city placement is declared to continue the record by LINK (new sector key, list name): rejoin() keeps the record id, list, child keys/order and object identity and ends only the new placement fresh record. A list is not served or extended while the city holds no placement (named refusal); a building can still be unlisted. C keeps the name per city (place_list_of_slot, with a listed count) and per building (place_parent_of_slot and the city slot), so no question names an ended placement; a real release clears the city list state and the buildings end the host list as they are released; a boot clears everything. No campaign policy or Core state moved; no query-time rebuild, no detached store; the setter and its order are unchanged.
